WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.etl_loaded_at,
         p.subcategory AS sub_asof, cp.subcategory AS sub_current, p.category AS cat_asof, f.channel_code
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
)
SELECT sub_current, sub_asof, cat_asof, channel_code, count(*) n_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) n_distinct_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) n_distinct_rl,
       sum(quantity) units, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT sale_date) days, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_units, min(quantity) minq, max(quantity) maxq
FROM l WHERE sub_current = 'Interior Paint' OR sub_asof = 'Interior Paint'
GROUP BY ALL

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT sum(f.quantity) u, count(*) n
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), ctl AS (
  SELECT sum(units_sold) u, sum(receipts) r, count(*) d FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
), ret AS (
  SELECT sum(r.quantity_returned) q, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' THEN r.quantity_returned ELSE 0 END) q_in_period
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
), clos AS (SELECT count(*) c FROM ref_store_closure WHERE store_id=108)
SELECT mine.u AS my_units_all_products, ctl.u AS rpt_units, ctl.d AS rpt_days, ret.q AS returned_units_of_sales_in_period, ret.n AS return_lines, ret.q_in_period, clos.c AS closures FROM mine, ctl, ret, clos

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.store_id, s.store_name, cp.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
GROUP BY ALL
